seed: Shannon Byrne Susko, Master Deck with 2 Day Kick Off, November 2024, Metronomics.

slides.title: Leave with one shared plan.
slides.headline: Leave with one shared plan.
notes: Check that the financial and operating targets reconcile across the three-year, annual and quarterly plans.
Confirm every commitment and metric has an owner. Everything is on the board. Entering it in Metronome is homework.
Record the widget-based company metric and its definition. Keep the scoreboard accessible to the team.

panels.heading: Function Chart + KFFM
panels.support: Keep the maps, owners, handoffs and measures.

panels.heading: Purpose, values and ambition
panels.support: Capture the agreed purpose, values and BHAG.

panels.heading: 3HAG, 1HAG and QHAG
panels.support: Targets with owners, 3HAG capabilities, and priorities with a done-by date and a measure of success.

panels.heading: Individual commitments
panels.support: Each person’s critical number, priorities and professional development.

slides.title: Did we get what we came for?
slides.headline: Did we get what we came for?
notes: Read back the outcomes the team agreed at the start.
For each one, ask for a show of hands: answered, partly or still open.
Still open is fine. Add each open outcome to the homework with an owner and a date.
The sticky shows the coach’s outcome for the session. Ask the team whether it was met, along with their own.

artwork.alt: Byron’s sticky note, handwritten with: Team clarity and commitment.

slides.title: What is the homework?
slides.headline: What is the homework?
notes: Circle’s Kick Off guidance also assigns CEO/coach preparation: team assessment, Head of Company scorecard preparation and review before the next session. Confirm these privately with the CEO. Add any outcomes still open from the previous check, with owners.
Agree on an owner and completion date for each follow-through action. Confirm when the team will review completion.

In Metronome: Core Purpose, Core Values, BHAG, 3HAG, 1HAG, QHAG and individual priorities; each leader adds the priorities they own; the widget-based company metric, if defined; the Team View, built from the function chart.
Finance leader: add the primary widgets to this year’s forecast (Shannon’s Kick Off company homework).
Give every item an owner and a date (What, Owner, By When), as on the board’s Homework area. Review completion at the next agreed meeting.

panels.heading: Enter the plan
panels.support: The whole plan, each leader’s critical number and priorities, and the Team View from the function chart.

panels.heading: Widgets in the forecast
panels.support: Add the primary widgets to this year’s forecast.

panels.heading: Messages and huddles
panels.support: Share the 3 messages with your team the day after. Run the first daily huddle.

panels.heading: Prepare
panels.support: Read The 3HAG Way. Complete the Q1 prep survey.
